study.name: Retest: Phase 3a: H3 Consensus Voting — Track 2 (Text-Only, HIGH Thinking)
study.description:
Tests consensus voting with HIGH thinking level at elevated temperatures (T=0.3, T=0.7, T=1.0) using the text-only configuration with HIGH thinking enabled.
T=0.7 data already exists in the Phase 3a replication study (outputs/retest/phase3a-replication/high/). This study adds T=0.3 and T=1.0 to complete the temperature sweep and enable comparison with the minimal thinking text track.
The replication study found HIGH thinking + consensus at T=0.7 achieves F1=0.771 (21-of-30) — the best result in the study.
study.retest_notes: H3 consensus voting Track 2 (text-only) with HIGH thinking. K=30 for full threshold sweep. T=0.7 already available from the replication study; T=0.3 and T=1.0 are new.
